decision: PASS_GO for the corrected A90 Phase 3 resident-refresh F1 pstore classifier, exact Phase 2/Phase 3 starting-identity selection, and exact connected-D0 integer propagation. Phase 2 accepts only the canonical V2321 start; Phase 3 accepts only canonical V2321 or V3406 starts. Expected console/pmsg boot records warn and continue; crash-class, unknown, malformed, mixed, and boolean-imposter evidence fails closed. No device action was performed by this review.

reviewed_semantics.starting_identity: The retained Phase 2 lane accepts only exact native 0.9.285 build v2321-usb-clean-identity-rodata. Phase 3 accepts exactly either that canonical V2321 identity or native 0.11.161 build phase2-display-v1-native-handoff; unknown and mixed version/build identities are rejected.
reviewed_semantics.rollback: The only rollback is boot_linux_v2321_usb_clean_identity_rodata.img, 60882944 bytes, SHA256 ca978551aabe4b39563abaf529ccf2522054952d8b2ad852e632d26da88168cb, partition boot.
reviewed_semantics.candidate: The only candidate is candidate-boot-phase2-display-v1.img, 66379776 bytes, SHA256 3d3e66535654a62f83c5772caba27624acc160911307190de458154acaefdabb, partition boot.
reviewed_semantics.attempts: Durable candidate intent precedes dispatch, candidate_transfer_count is exactly one, candidate replay is false, and an uncertain candidate is never replayed.
reviewed_semantics.phase3_materialization: The Phase 3 keyer, exact pristine source and receipt, retained service and firstboot content, filesystem label, observer key pair, runtime absence, provenance, and dynamic support-file closure are hash-bound and validated.
reviewed_semantics.connected_d0: The exact A90 bridge/realpath, single matching USB parent, host NCM readiness, exact profile-selected native identity facts, selftest fail=0, pstore entries=0, artifacts, flash runner, and path absence are bound read-only evidence. Count, pstore, selftest, artifact size, preflight source size, and framed RC fields require exact Python int values and reject booleans.
reviewed_semantics.resident_install_v2: Success requires one exact candidate health result and closes PASS_A90_RESIDENT_INSTALLED in RESIDENT_HEALTHY with zero resident reboot and zero rollback. Console/pmsg boot records are classified warnings; crash-class, unknown, or malformed records stop. Post-attempt failure or ambiguity enters exact V2321 rollback recovery and cannot replay the candidate.
reviewed_semantics.boundaries: Only boot payloads are reachable; forbidden partitions and forbidden write mechanisms remain excluded; rollback and final health remain mandatory; A90 and S22+ authority and evidence remain isolated.

findings_closed_before_decision: The resident manifest builder now rebinds Phase 3 profile, label, support closure, resident starting identity, and approval materialization scope instead of retaining the Phase 2 template selection.
The resident manifest builder now hard-pins the canonical candidate and V2321 rollback names, sizes, hashes, versions, builds, and boot partition.
Connected and F1 starting-health parsing now requires exact framed identity, selftest, and pstore facts instead of substring matches.
Phase 3 pristine provenance is always rebound from the exact Phase 3 keyed summary source and receipt rather than retaining stale Phase 2 provenance.
The pstore parser now rejects duplicate or conflicting entries tokens, including entries=0 followed by a nonzero value.
The post-reboot pstore classifier accepts only exact console/pmsg boot-record names and rejects dmesg, ftrace, unknown names, malformed nonempty lines, and mixed malformed output.

One shared exact receipt validator preserves the historical six-key schema only when entries and reparsed listing are both empty, while accepting the new classified nine-key schema for install and D1 consumption.
Source self-audit and mutation tests bind the pstore allowlist, framing grammar, return schema, read-only order, and absence of cleanup or write commands.

Starting-identity sets, the profile-selection helper, the staging general/profile gates, and the finalizer Phase 2/Phase 3 branch are exact-bound so widening, disabling, or unknown-identity mutations fail self-audit.
The staging loader enforces V2321-only for legacy Phase 2 and exact V2321-or-V3406 for Phase 3, closing the prior runtime path that admitted V3406 to Phase 2.

Connected D0 and path receipt validators reject boolean values masquerading as integer count, pstore, selftest, artifact-size, preflight-size, or framed-RC evidence; runtime and adversarial mutation regressions cover each gate.
